metadata.sql:
SELECT 
    p1.driver_code,
    p1.driver_name,
    p1.constructor,
    p1.position,
    p1.year,
    p1.grand_prix,
    (p2.finish_ms - p1.finish_ms) / 1000.0 AS winning_margin_seconds,
    p2.finish_time AS winning_margin
FROM v_race_results p1
JOIN v_race_results p2 
    ON p1.race_id = p2.race_id 
   AND p2.position = 2
WHERE p1.year = 2021
  AND ((lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(p1.circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(p1.grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(p1.circuit_country) = 'brazil'))
  AND p1.position = 1
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix and what was the winning margin over P2?
